source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Build one independently randomized, photographically testable adult scene for the achievement reward smile profile, use the attached image only as the main subject's appearance reference, and render visible evidence that can be judged from pixels rather than inferred as an inner mental state.
subject: one unmistakably adult polar field glaciologist whose visible facial appearance is guided only by Image 1, accompanied by one adult expedition teammate
setting: a blue-ice tunnel laboratory at polar twilight with frost-rimmed field equipment
event: the main glaciologist has just restarted a compact borehole sensor after a frost-stiffened cable failure, and the teammate begins securing the recovered sample
visual_priorities: achievement reward smile shown as a mostly symmetric upward pull at both lip corners with gently raised cheeks
visible successful result through green status lamps and a stable live waveform
result-directed three-quarter gaze toward the restarted instrument
post-success consequence through the teammate lowering the emergency crank and sealing the recovered ice-core sample
appearance continuity from Image 1 without importing personality or psychological meaning
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary expedition photograph inside a blue-ice tunnel laboratory at polar twilight. One unmistakably adult polar field glaciologist, whose visible facial appearance follows Image 1 only, has just restarted a compact borehole sensor after a frost-stiffened cable failure. Show an achievement reward smile: a mostly symmetric upward pull at both lip corners with gently raised cheeks, while their three-quarter face and eyes remain directed toward the instrument's now-glowing green status lamps and a stable waveform on its rugged display. Their gloved hand still rests beside the reset lever. A second adult teammate in an orange cold-weather suit lowers the emergency hand crank and begins sealing the recovered ice-core sample, making the post-success consequence visible. Include frost-rimmed cables, a field notebook, translucent ice strata, and condensed breath. Cyan light transmitted through the ice mixes with warm amber task lamps. Keep the face, successful result, and teammate consequence readable in one coherent frame; natural skin texture, realistic fabric, restrained expedition color.
